    while True:
        if turn % 2 == 1:  # Vladik's turn
            if b > a:
                return "Valera"
            a += 1
            b -= 1
        else:  # Valera's turn
            if a > b:
                return "Vladik"
            b += 1
            a -= 1
        turn += 1
